description: We are a team of curious problem-solvers, coders, and space enthusiasts united by a passion for exploring the unknown. Driven by NASA’s open data, we build creative, scalable solutions to tackle real-world challenges on Earth and in space.
summary:
The Moon & Mars Remembers: A Solar Tale is an interactive, illustrated space documentary experience that chronicles human and robotic space exploration through the eyes and voices of celestial bodies.

What we developed: A web-based narrative storybook covering historic NASA missions—from Apollo 11, Surveyor 3, and ALSEP to Viking, Spirit & Opportunity, InSight, Dawn, Ingenuity, and Kepler. It features 160+ illustrated story scenes with calm, neural voice narrations for each mission card, gentle floating celestial characters, and automated scroll-driven storytelling.
How it addresses the challenge: Complex NASA mission telemetry and historical archives often feel intimidating or inaccessible to youth and educators. Our project transforms dense mission data into an empathetic, first-person narrative where planets and moons recount their encounters with humanity’s explorers, making space history intuitive and emotionally resonant.
Why it is important: It inspires the next generation of explorers by bridging rigorous space science with accessible, artistic storytelling. By portraying exploration as ancient worlds welcoming earthly visitors, it makes planetary science memorable and inclusive for learners of all ages.
details:
🌕 Details

The Moon Remembers & Mars Remembers is an interactive digital storybook told from the perspectives of the Moon and Mars — ancient cosmic observers welcoming humanity's brave robotic and crewed visitors. Across multiple mission sections, the story chronicles more than 50 years of space exploration: from the quiet dust of Apollo 11, Surveyor 3, and ALSEP to Viking landers, the twin rovers Spirit and Opportunity, InSight's seismic listening, Ingenuity's historic Martian flights, and Kepler’s search for other worlds. The project bridges authentic planetary science and emotional documentary storytelling.

💻 Tech Stack

  • Frontend Framework: React, TypeScript, TanStack Router & TanStack Start
  • Styling & Components: Tailwind CSS, Radix UI Primitives, Lucide Icons
  • Audio Engine: Custom HTMLAudioElement & Web Audio API architecture with IntersectionObserver scroll-triggering
  • Typography: Google Fonts: Fraunces (Editorial Serif) & Nunito (Humanist Sans)
  • Build & Deployment: Vite, Cloudflare Nitro, Netlify/Vercel ready (Mobile-First Responsive Design)

✨ Innovation Highlights

  • 📖 First-Person Celestial Perspective: 160+ illustrated story cards narrated by the Moon, Mars, and visiting worlds (Vesta, Ceres, Eros, Jupiter, Ingenuity).
  • 🎙️ Intelligent Voice Narration: Pure card-only narration with distinct voice identities (calm, gentle Moon; deep, adventurous Mars) that never read UI clutter or headers.
  • 📜 Auto-Narrate on Scroll: Seamless viewport detection that plays stories as the user scrolls, with anti-overlap and rapid-scroll debouncing.
  • 🎨 Expressive Character Design: Gentle, lifelike idle floating and eye-blinking animations with natural expressions.
  • 📡 NASA Data Fidelity: Every scene is anchored in real mission dates, instruments, scientific discoveries, and landing sites sourced from NASA archives.

🤖 Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)

💻 AI tools/software:

  • Edge-TTS / Neural Speech: High-fidelity neural voice synthesis for Moon (en-US-JennyNeural) and Mars (en-US-ChristopherNeural)
  • Google Gemini: Scientific research, code architecture, script generation, and TanStack Start optimization
  • ChatGPT: Mission storytelling drafts, dialogue refinement, and archival verification
  • AI Image Generation (Lovable / Stable Diffusion): Space documentary watercolor illustrations and planetary landscapes
